E0102

Nothing named `pirnt` exists here

What

Nothing named `pirnt` exists here

Why

Only functions that have been defined (or built in, like `print` / `input`) can be called

Fix

Did you mean `print`?

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0102: tests/ui/args_spec_bad_flag_arity.stderr.

Error [E1301]: `flag` expects 2 arguments (name, help), got 1
  --> tests/ui/args_spec_bad_flag_arity.jet:5:25
    |
  5 |     spec :: args.spec().flag("verbose")
    |                         ^^^^
 Why: `ArgsSpec.flag(name, help)` registers a boolean flag like `--verbose`
 Fix: Pass exactly two strings: the flag name and a help description
